name: Heartspire
storyline: You are the last Warden of the Heartspire. At the top of the tower burns the Heart, a buried ember that keeps the valley's dead asleep, and everything that crawls out of the dark wants it. The Thorn King climbs to wake the forest, with the Mother of Crows as his herald. The Sexton rings his bell for the tower's own dead, who were never allowed to rest. The Drowned Bishop, who once sealed the Heart away, rises to take it back. Waiting at the summit is the Hollow Saint: the first Warden, emptied out by an age of guarding it.
summary:
The dead wood is climbing. You are the last Warden of the Heartspire. At the top of the tower burns the Heart, the buried ember that keeps the valley's dead asleep. Twig sprites, grave gnomes, briar elves and worse are climbing toward it, and your only weapon is the wall itself.

Heartspire is a gothic tower defense puzzle in which blocks fall in real time around a tower you turn beneath them. Fill a whole ring and it shatters, sending a blast up the tower that strikes every creature above it. Clear two rings at once or set off a chain and the blast hits harder, and if you stack too high the tower cracks.
